scope: Ordinary embedded-source module loader, UTF-8 scalar decoding and transactional text-edit reuse. String projection remains an explicit failure; this is not complete standard-library or terminal acceptance.

identity.source_hashes: Independently recomputed SHA256 of all nine exact Git blobs listed in terminal-345.json; all match.
identity.binding: Author identified this harness as built from exact implementation commit; reviewer copied and hashed it before target reuse. Source fixtures and embedded library inputs are compile-time include_str inputs. No author Clippy result is attributed to reviewer execution.

controls: Actual native UTF-8 and transactional-edit source executions exit zero, with no stdout/stderr, current Verify count one and no backend fallback.
A same-name invalid filesystem std/utf8.zil cannot replace the distributed source.
After a positive manual ProjectSources compilation, altered reserved library bytes reject with E-STD-RESERVED; private helper access rejects.
Exact cumulative source-byte N=7945 succeeds twice; N-1 rejects in warm and fresh sessions without an executable.

source_review: validate_sources checks unique module/file IDs, charges module lookup and expected byte comparison, and checks exact reserved-module bytes before project fingerprints or cache use.
Both manual-project import resolution and filesystem discovery reject unknown standard modules and nonordinary standard imports; manually supplying std.meta/std.syntax through project paths rejects.

Embedded sources use ordinary import, expansion, Types, Analyze and Verify paths. Their actual bytes enter the project identity and source-byte limits; no standard-module semantic trust privilege is added.

Virtual standard paths and canonical absolute filesystem paths cannot collide in discovery. Filesystem discovery receipt publication cannot canonicalize a virtual path to the identical source spelling. Optional discovered semantic hits call validate_sources before restoring a typed candidate.

UTF-8 implementation rejects overlong, surrogate, out-of-range and truncated forms; decoding bounds and scalar offsets remain ordinary checked source operations. Existing text-edit code reserves before mutation and retains its transactional failure contract.
limitations: Unknown-standard-module, manually supplied compiler-module and persistent-discovery-cache paths were reviewed in source; they were not additional independently executed tests in this replay.
The String source consumer still fails on projecting Managed(ByteBuffer) through &String. No String execution or complete collections/ZUI claim is made.
No workspace-wide, native Windows, product-performance or terminal-language gate was run by this review.
